t_advice_summary_textbox.text: It says to  test the gnomes on the 1x round to see which gives higher points, the multiplyer tends to stay on the same side. green hats and pointy have better chances

vb_textbox.text: A new round is when the town appears. The higest reward normally tends to stay onthe same side. I found in the first 2 rounds red and pointy hat gnomes had more mushrooms. use x1 rounds to test for the highest score. on the 3 and 4th round the round hat gnomes tended to give high scores espically the green hat gnome. Each main round im talking about starts after the 5min break
